requirement.evidence: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
requirement.note: Source of income is a protected category under the Fair Housing Ordinance, and the ordinance prohibits discrimination in renting and in terms and conditions of tenancy. The complaint process and phone number are also stated. The page does not say outright that landlords may not refuse to rent because of voucher status; that follows from the protected-category list.
